title: Office membership (My offices, join, leave, staff, emergency changes)
description: Read-only checks of the redesigned office membership screens (docs/plans/office-membership-ux-redesign-plan.md): My offices for a storekeeper (statuses, home tag, roles with Hand over or a labelled Cancel, handovers waiting, updates); Join another office refusing an unknown code under the field without creating a request; the guided Leave page blocked by a held role; the Staff page's five tab counts and a refused Add staff that keeps the typed values and adds nobody; employee and administrator boundaries; and Emergency changes (needs a super user, so it is blocked on the seeded dataset). Counts are compared with the database. The write journey membership.handover-decline is in the journeys suite. Run after any change to packages/gov-store/office-membership or the theming workflow kit.
